trips.waitlist: Waiting for the taxi to launch in the city

text.driver_requirements: Requirements for drivers (documents, experience) and cars depend on the city and country. A manager will provide them after your application. Apply as a driver and we will tell you what is needed in your city.
text.driver_cabinet: The driver cabinet opens once your application is approved. It will hold your orders, rides and income. Apply as a driver and we will let you know when the cabinet is available.
text.driver_income: Your income and payouts will appear here. The platform does not transfer money itself. This section opens when the taxi starts in your city.
text.info_about: “Taxi for your own” is a platform service for passengers and drivers from your community. The taxi launches city by city: leave a request in your city and we will tell you when it starts.
text.info_how: A passenger creates a request: city, address, wishes. If the taxi already works in the city, drivers see it. If not, we add you to the waiting list and tell you about the launch.
text.info_drivers: Become a driver: submit an application and a manager will contact you. After approval the driver cabinet opens.
text.info_partner: Partner program: invite drivers and passengers with your link and grow the service in your city. Cooperation and reward terms are set separately and are not a guarantee of income.
text.info_regions: You can create a team in your city, become a regional representative or open the service in your country. Submit an application and a manager will explain the terms.
text.info_terms: Cooperation and reward terms are agreed individually and set separately. They are not a guarantee of income.
text.info_news: Project news will appear here. Right now we are launching the taxi city by city and collecting requests from passengers and drivers.
text.payment_tariffs: Fares depend on the city and car class and will appear when the taxi starts in your city.
text.payment_methods: Payment methods will be announced before launch in your city. The platform does not transfer money itself.
text.payment_receipts: Receipts will appear after the first rides.
text.payment_settlements: The platform does not transfer money itself. The settlement procedure with drivers will be announced before launch in the city.
text.payment_fees: Fees and payment terms are set separately before launch in the city. The platform does not transfer money itself.

text.info_about: The real estate agency brings together property, home goods and moving services in one place for Ukrainians in different countries. You can buy or rent a home, sell or give away items and find loaders and movers.
text.info_how: Buy and rent property in “Buy property” and “Rent property”: choose the type, country and city, contact the owner or book a viewing. In “Everything for home” sell items or give them away for free. Need to move? Leave a request and see performers in your city.
text.info_news: News, new features and platform updates will appear here.

moving.noneInCity: No performers in {city} yet. We will let you know when they appear.

std.howSpecialist: How to become a project specialist

text.about: Everything for our people in one place: catalog, requests and contacts. The platform is free; the system never moves money between participants — payments are agreed directly.
text.how: Pick a folder, browse listings or submit a request. Performers and administrators will see it; request status is shown in “My requests”. Always clarify details and check your partner before any deal.
text.earn: Become a specialist, partner or representative. Submit an application — administrators will review it and get in touch. The platform is free; earnings depend on your own agreements with clients and no income is guaranteed.
text.news: Project news will appear here. Follow updates and propose topics via “Suggestions and complaints”.
text.howPlace: Submit an application with the project description, required amount and contacts. After administrator review the project appears in the catalog. The platform only introduces the parties and does not guarantee funding.
text.howInvestor: Create an investor profile: budget, industries and participation formats. The profile can be open or hidden. Any investment carries risk — check projects yourself; the platform gives no financial advice and guarantees no profit.
text.howSpecialist: Pick your specialty and apply with your experience and contacts. After review you will receive requests from project authors.
text.growth: Clubs are a place to grow skills and learn. A specialist who completed training and holds the required qualification and license (where the law requires it) can apply to the “Jobs” project. A club course certificate is not automatically equal to a state qualification or license.

text.info_about: Jobs for our people in different countries: vacancies and candidates in one catalog.
text.info_how: Employers add vacancies by country and region. Job seekers browse or submit a request, which appears in “My requests”. Check the employer before traveling or paying for any services.

text.info_about: Buying, renting and everything for cars: owner listings and specialized online shops.
text.info_how: Choose a section, filter by country and region, contact the owner. Can’t find it — submit a selection request. Check the car and papers before buying.

text.info_about: Ukrainian goods by department: food, clothing, household chemicals, souvenirs, electronics, plus delivery and partner shops and warehouses abroad.
text.info_how: Open a department, pick a sub-department and a partner shop. Shop owners can apply for their own department. Order delivery via carriers in “Delivery and logistics”.

text.info_about: Doctors, nutrition, sport, psychology, recovery and health goods — specialists who understand our people.
text.info_how: Choose a direction, find a specialist and request a consultation. Information here does not replace diagnosis or treatment: see a doctor for medical care.

health.intro: Doctors, nutrition, sport, psychology, recovery and health goods. This is information, not medical advice.

text.info_about: Helper for an hour: masters, loaders and tool rental near you.
text.info_how: Describe what needs doing and performers in your city will respond. Masters create a cabinet and form teams in a city, region or country. Agree terms and payment directly.
text.cabinet_create: Submit the “Become a master or specialist” application. After administrator review you get a cabinet: profile, services, orders, reviews and settings.

text.info_about: Translators and translation of documents and texts by language and country.
text.info_how: Choose a language and submit a request with description and deadline. Send only a description via the form; hand over original documents directly to the translator after agreeing.

text.info_about: Business Speed — a set of services to launch and grow a business: specialists, partners and other platform projects.
text.info_how: Pick business specialists, request partner matching or find a sales market. Administrators will respond to your request.

turnkey.intro: Business Speed — help starting and growing a business: specialists, partners, sales markets and platform projects.

text.info_about: A place where project authors, investors and specialists meet. The platform only introduces parties, takes no part in deals and guarantees no funding or profit.
text.info_how: Authors submit projects, investors create a profile (open or hidden), specialists offer services. Parties settle everything themselves; investing involves risk.

invest.intro: Projects, investors and specialists. The platform only introduces parties; investing involves risk.

text.info_about: Tours, hot offers, tickets and insurance for our people.
text.info_how: Submit a request for a tour, holiday selection or tickets — the reply appears in “My requests”. Hot offers disappear after the date passes or when no seats remain.

travel.intro: Tours, hot offers, tickets and insurance. Pick a holiday or submit a request.

text.info_about: Everything for pets: animals, shops, vets, training, grooming, pet sitting, travel and help for animals.
text.info_how: Choose an animal type and breed, shops or specialists, submit service requests. Check documents and terms before buying or boarding.
text.travel_docs: Before traveling with an animal check destination rules: microchip, rabies vaccination, veterinary certificate. Rules change — confirm with official services.
text.travel_rules: Carriers have their own rules on weight, carriers and breeds. Confirm terms with the airline or carrier in advance.

pets.intro: Animals, shops, vets, training, grooming, pet sitting and help for animals — all in one place.

text.info_about: Fairs of Ukrainian products worldwide: producer and seller applications and fair organizers.
text.info_how: Producers apply, organizers in countries or cities form teams and venues. Participation in fairs is not guaranteed; details are agreed with the organizer.

trade.intro: Fairs of Ukrainian products abroad: producers apply, organizers form teams and venues.

text.info_about: Interest clubs: hunters, anglers, pet lovers, drivers, motorcyclists, cyclists, knitting, cooking and pastry. Each club has communities by country and city, a bulletin board, shop, bloggers, courses, events and specialists.
text.info_how: Pick a club, join a local community or apply for a branch or representation. Applications for leadership, new clubs and directions are moderated. Only lawful goods and services are allowed.

clubs.intro: Interest clubs: chat, ads, shops, training, events and specialists in your city and country.

text.info_about: The Antiques shop brings together owners of antique and precious items, collectors, buyers, shops, appraisers, experts and masters from different countries.
text.info_how: Post listings in online shops, add an offline shop, find an appraiser or expert. The platform does not allow illegal trade in cultural property, archaeological finds or precious metals contrary to law; check provenance and export rules.

antiques.intro: Antiques and precious items: online and offline shops, appraisers, experts and masters. Illegal trade in cultural property is prohibited.
